newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta issues 1.8 mln pounds in treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Malta issues 1.8 mln pounds in treasury bills.

text.p: The Malta Treasury on Friday issues 1.8 million Malta pounds in 28-day treasury bills maturing on May 30. The yield rate is 5.0211 percent per annum, unchanged from the previous issue on April 18.

The Treasury will also issue 487,000 pounds ($1.2m) in 91-day bills maturing on August 1, 1997. The yield rate is 5.0295 percent, slightly down from 5.0299 percent in the previous 91-day issue on April 25, 1987.
